component.name: Soplos WebApp Manager
component.summary: Create and manage isolated Web Applications

description.p: Soplos WebApp Manager lets you run websites as native desktop applications. It creates isolated browsing profiles (Site Specific Browsers) so a webapp never shares cookies or open tabs with your main browsing session, using whichever browser you already have installed.

screenshot.caption: Main window with the hero banner and the list of WebApps
Editing a WebApp's name, address, icon and browser
Help for the extra browser launch parameters
Adding a new WebApp with automatic favicon lookup

description.p: First beta of the Tauri-based rewrite of Soplos WebApp Manager.

ul.li: New hero banner with the language switcher and the Add/Remove controls
Keyboard shortcuts for every common action
Drag and drop a link from the browser to create a WebApp
Many more browsers detected, including LibreWolf, Zen Browser and Opera
Automatic fix for a blank window in virtual machines

description.p: First alpha of the Tauri-based rewrite of Soplos WebApp Manager.
